text: How North Korea Hid an IT Workforce Inside US Companies | Bloomberg InvestigatesThis is the story of Christina Chapman, a suburban TikTok creator who ran a covert “laptop farm” from her Arizona home. The scheme became a gateway for North Korean IT operatives who infiltrated US companies and, according to the Justice Department, funneled millions of dollars to the North Korean government.
